raw_text:
PLAN "Minimalist Bodyweight Strength with Pull-Up Bar"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper A - Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x2..4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower A - Squat Hinge Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B - Push Focus":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 4x2..4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pike_push_up 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
